messages:
maria_gonzalez: Kickoff for Helios Health POC — tentative Wed 2026-04-01 10:00 PT. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and surface any enterprise blockers before we send the invite. Main use case: clinical triage summarization + question answering over internal protocols. Can @alex_chen (solutions) and @samir_patel (security) confirm availability and any hard constraints?

alex_chen: I'm available Wed. Quick Q — do they want embeddings-based retrieval or simple RAG with full-text? If retrieval, what's their vector store preference (Redis/Weaviate/FAISS) and expected corpus size? Also confirm whether they want hosted or Dedicated for the pilot.

tasha_wong: Pricing ask from their CFO: ballpark for a 30-day pilot at ~100k tokens/day and 5 users. Also whether we can provide a pilot credit and any SOW template.

samir_patel: Security note — they asked for SOC2 evidence + a completed security questionnaire. Crucial question: will PHI be in scope? If yes, we need to push Private deployment / VPC + IRB checklist. I can share the redacted questionnaire but need to know data types.

ops_bot: Security questionnaire template & intake form: https://drive.internal/redwood/helios-security-template and https://forms.internal/helios-intake. Reminder: set retention to 7 days for pilot org.

alex_chen: Proposed success criteria to validate in the POC (suggest we lock these before kickoff):
1) Answer accuracy >= 85% on a 200-prompt eval set agreed with customer
2) 95th-pct latency <= 600ms for typical queries under pilot concurrency
3) Hallucination rate (irrelevant/confident wrong) < 5% on red-team prompts
4) Integration: app can call Redwood API with auth + ingest sample docs within 2 weeks
5) Business metric: reduce triage-handling time by 20% on sample workload (optional to measure)

maria_gonzalez: Add that the customer wants traceability for every answer (source citations) and a plan for fallback to a human triage flow if confidence < threshold.

tasha_wong: For pricing: hosted small model + 100k tokens/day is approx $X/day — I will DM exact numbers and suggest we offer $Y in pilot credits and a short SOW (30 days, success criteria + acceptance tests).

samir_patel: Discovery questions to send before pre-kickoff: 1) Will PHI/PII be included? 2) Data formats (PDF, EHR JSON, HL7)? 3) Estimated corpus size (GB, # docs) and update frequency? 4) Expected QPS / peak concurrency and typical query size? 5) Auth method (SAML/Okta/API keys)? 6) Acceptance tests and any internal eval datasets they can share? 7) Compliance contacts + legal reviewer.

maria_gonzalez: I'll schedule a 30-min pre-kickoff sync with Helios for Monday to collect those answers. Can someone draft the calendar invite + agenda? Suggested agenda: intro (5m), scope & use cases (10m), data access & security checklist (5m), success criteria & eval plan (5m), timeline & next steps (5m).

alex_chen: I'll draft the invite and attach a minimal eval prompt set. Sample prompts (we'll expand to 200 later):
```
1) Summarize protocol X in 3 bullets.
2) Given patient symptoms A,B,C, what are the next recommended steps?
3) Find any contradictory guidance across documents for procedure Y.
```
I'll also include a short README on how we expect them to label eval answers.

tasha_wong: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a pricing slide + POC SOW template and share in the invite.

maria_gonzalez: Ops — can you provision a sandbox org and temporary API key for them? Need an isolated tenant and admin creds that expire after the pilot.

ops_bot: Sandbox org created: helios-pilot-2026. Temporary API key generated (expires in 30 days). Console link: https://console.redwood/sandbox/helios-pilot-2026. Retention set to 7 days.

maria_gonzalez: Closing actions: alex to draft invite + attach prompts by EOD today, tasha to prepare pricing + SOW, samir to confirm PHI implications and send preliminary security Qs. I'll confirm meeting time with the customer after we get their availability. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
